name: Minion
help: You play for the wolves but do not wake with them. You learn who they are on the first night. The Seer sees you as a villager. (With the picked minion setting the wolves choose a player instead of dealing this card.)

call.label: PICK MINION
call.title: Wolves, choose your minion
call.subtitle: Pick a player to serve the pack
call.instruction: Right-click the player you pick as your minion (the wolves must agree)
